title: Is RV Life Right for You?
intro: Answer 7 quick questions to see how well the RV lifestyle fits your habits, goals, and comfort with the open road. This is just for fun and self-reflection, not a verdict.

questions.q: How do you feel about living in a small, multi-use space where the bed, kitchen, and couch are all a few steps apart?

options.t: Cozy and freeing, less stuff to manage
I could adjust if it meant more adventure
I need my room to spread out and breathe

questions.q: When a trip plan falls apart, the campground's full, or the route closes, how do you usually react?

options.t: Shrug and find a Plan B, that's half the fun
A little stressed, but I figure it out
It really rattles me, I like things locked in

questions.q: How handy are you with fixing or maintaining things yourself?

options.t: I enjoy tinkering and learning to fix stuff
Not a pro, but I'll watch a video and try
I'd rather call someone every time

questions.q: What does your ideal vacation look like?

options.t: Roaming, changing scenery, nights under the stars
A mix of exploring and a comfy home base
A nice hotel or resort with everything handled

questions.q: How do you feel about disconnecting from reliable internet and city conveniences for stretches at a time?

options.t: Sounds peaceful, I want less screen time anyway
Fine for a while if I can reconnect when needed
I need solid Wi-Fi and amenities close by

questions.q: How do you and the people (or pets) you'd travel with handle close quarters for days on end?

options.t: We genuinely enjoy each other's company
Mostly good with a little space now and then
We'd be at each other's throats by day two

questions.q: How ready are you to learn new skills like backing up a rig, dumping tanks, and boondocking?

options.t: Bring it on, I love learning by doing
Nervous but willing to practice
Honestly that all sounds like a lot of hassle

results.title: RV life might not be your easiest fit right now
results.body: Your answers suggest you value comfort, space, and predictability, which is completely valid. That doesn't mean the road isn't for you, it just means a full leap could feel rough. A great way to test the waters is to rent an RV for a weekend or book a cabin-style camp stay before committing to anything bigger.
results.cta: Read our RV rental and first-trip guide

results.title: RV life could work well for you, with a plan
results.body: You've got a real mix of adventurous spirit and healthy realism, which is a strong foundation. With the right rig size, a few practiced skills, and a flexible itinerary, you could enjoy this lifestyle a lot. Start by figuring out what type of RV matches how you actually like to travel.
results.cta: Explore our RV types and buying basics

results.title: You're a strong fit for RV life
results.body: Flexibility, curiosity, and a hands-on streak, you check the big boxes. You'd likely thrive whether you go part-time on weekends or dive toward full-time travel. Now it's about dialing in the details: rig setup, must-have gear, and finding your favorite places to roam.
results.cta: Dive into our full-time RV and gear guides

disclaimer: This quiz is just for fun and self-reflection, not professional advice. Only you can decide what lifestyle is right for you.
